title: Find female patients diagnosed with SLE who have either abnormal fibrinogen
question: Find female patients diagnosed with SLE who have either abnormal fibrinogen levels or abnormally high uric acid (above the normal female range), and whose total protein is below the normal lower limit. For these patients, return their ID, sex, birthday, and the three anti-Cardiolipin antibody concentrations.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."XCL_058",
    p."XCL_059",
    p."XCL_060",
    l."XCL_041",
    l."XCL_042",
    l."XCL_043"
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p."XCL_058" = l."XCL_014"
WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND p."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND (
    l."XCL_036" < 200 OR l."XCL_036" > 400
    OR l."XCL_022" > 6.5
  )
  AND l."XCL_020" < 6.0
